What's got you feeling hesitant about it?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Well, it’s far from where I live, in a completely different area, and the pay is pretty low."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"That sounds really challenging. Moving and taking a pay cut are big decisions. What are your main concerns?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Mainly, it's about leaving behind what little network I have here and starting over somewhere else for something that doesn’t seem worth it."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Leaving familiar places and people can be really tough. It makes sense that you'd feel conflicted."},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"Exactly. I keep thinking, is it worth uprooting everything just for the sake of a job that might not even cover my basic expenses?"},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"Your concerns are completely valid. Financial stability and having support around is really important. Have you considered any alternatives?"},{"speaker":"seeker","text":"I've been looking for more opportunities around here, but they are few and far between. It’s making me feel pretty trapped."},{"speaker":"supporter","text":"It must be frustrating to feel like your options are limited. How do you usually handle situations like this?"}]
